title: Rewrite the function
text: Write $$e^{2x}=e^2 e^{2\left(x-1\right)}$$ and use the Maclaurin series of $$e^u$$ with $$u=2\left(x-1\right)$$.

title: Read off the coefficient
text: The term with $$\left(x-1\right)^3$$ is $$\frac{e^2 \left(2\left(x-1\right)\right)^3}{6}$$, so the coefficient is $$\frac{8e^2}{6}=\frac{4e^2}{3}$$.
